title: Only 2 of 400 catalogue documents are draftable
description: The catalogue contains 400 document types but only 2 (Mutual NDA, Patent Application) have full drafting capability (L3 DRAFTABLE). The remaining 398 are metadata-only (L0 CATALOGUED).
impact: Users see 400 document types in the UI but can only draft 2. This creates false competence perception.
root_cause: Document profiles not created for most catalogue entries. Only 2 profiles exist in data/documents/profiles/.
remediation: Create document profiles for remaining golden set documents, then expand to full catalogue.
regression_test: Capability matrix audit should fail if L3 count < golden set size (25).
